hook: Seven qubits built a three-electron Laughlin state. Its hidden many-body coherence showed up.
hook_turn: Its hidden many-body coherence showed up.
summary: Using seven superconducting qubits, the team prepared a three-electron fractional quantum Hall state and reconstructed its full density matrix. Coherence among vortex-dressed particles extended over longer distances than electron coherence, and a quasihole showed fractional charge response and a geometric-phase signature. It is a tiny system of three electrons, so the findings are checked only against finite-size benchmarks.
title: Hidden Coherence and Controlled Quasihole Motion in a Fermionic Laughlin State on a Superconducting Quantum Processor
